title: Bad UX: incorrect default setting for "sort_scripts_by"
body:
### Tested versions

- Reproducible in: 4.5.stable.official [876b29003]

### System information

Godot v4.5.stable - macOS Monterey (12.6.0) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - Metal (Forward+) - integrated Apple M1 (Apple7) - Apple M1 (8 threads) - 8.00 GiB memory

### Issue description

**Issue:**  
The setting for "sort_scripts_by" is set to "Name" by default, resulting in a lessened (more confusing) default experience for new users.

**Reasoning:**
_An alphabetically auto-resorted script list creates the following UX issues:_
- Non-standard organization for most coding programs (standard: newly opened scripts are added to the end of the currently opened list/tabs).
- Users are unlikely to know the position of their scripts by first letter, and thus users will likely have to consistently relocate where a previously opened script is.
- When a scene is opened/clicked in the tab, it's script (if it has one) is added to the script list, resulting in a list that becomes more difficult to navigate over time.
- A constant auto-reordering list results in a user with lessened control of how their scripts are organized.
- Any manual user reorganization via drag-and-drop is undermined once a new script is added.
- The usefulness of right-click-option "close tabs below" is lessened as users will likely need to reorganize their list manually first.

**Solution:**
Change "sort_scripts_by" default setting to "None" instead of "Name", solving the listed UX issues.




### Steps to reproduce

Editor Settings location:  
text_editor/script_list/sort_scripts_by
